scenes.headline: How an agent measures a construction drawing
scenes.sub: Pixels to square feet, and pencil until a person inks it.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Joist! Here's how an agent measures floors on a construction drawing, and why a person still signs every number.

scenes.text: One engine for the estimator and the agent: the scale gates every number, and agent work stays pencil until a person accepts it.
scenes.say: One measuring engine for a person and an agent. No scale, no numbers. And the agent's work stays pencil until a person accepts it.

scenes.title: From a traced ring to square feet
scenes.text: SF = shoelace(px) x upp x upp
scenes.say: Every coordinate is an image pixel.

parts.note: the ring's area in image pixels
parts.say: Trace the room as a ring, and the shoelace sum gives its area in pixels.
Multiply by the scale, squared. Two percent off in length is four percent off in area.

scenes.title: One room, from sheet to bid

steps.say: The plan is a sheet of vector lines. Until its scale is set, every measuring tool refuses.
The agent reads the wall strokes and traces each room on the inner wall face.
Totals multiply identical floors, then add waste only to the order.

steps.note: pending pencil still counts in totals
steps.say: The agent's shapes land in one unreviewed batch. The estimator accepts it with one click.

scenes.title: Counting symbols without a vision model
scenes.say: Counting fixtures is geometry, not vision.

items.say: Box one example of the symbol.
Its rarest line lengths vote for every place it could sit, turned or mirrored.
Each placement scores how much of the symbol it reproduces.
A high score counts. A near-miss comes back as a question, never a silent guess.

scenes.credit: the project's README, agent review walkthrough
scenes.title: Pencil, waiting for a person

steps.say: Here is an agent's takeoff in the browser: six rooms, one Accept pill.
Dashed, pending your review. Accept turns pencil to ink.

scenes.label: on a default build: 55 registered, the two flood-fill tools gated off
scenes.note: counted from the server's own registrations

scenes.text: Refuse when a unit is missing, return near-misses as questions, and keep the human's mark out of the agent's reach.
scenes.mark: keep the human's mark out of the agent's reach
scenes.say: Refuse when a unit is missing. Return near-misses as questions. And keep the human's mark out of the agent's reach.

recap: The scale squared sets every area
